# YourDictionary.com

> > A comprehensive English language reference providing dictionary definitions, sentence examples, and word usage demonstrations across thousands of terms, idioms, and phrasal verbs.

YourDictionary.com serves as a practical language learning resource with real-world sentence examples featuring historical figures, contemporary contexts, and specialized terminology. The site focuses on helping users understand proper word usage through contextual examples rather than just definitions.

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [ABOUT Definition & Meaning | Dictionary.com](https://dictionary.com/browse/about): Dictionary.com entry defining 'about' as preposition, adverb, adjective
- [ABOUT | English meaning - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/about): Cambridge Dictionary definition with pronunciation and usage examples

- [Examples of "Quarantined" in a Sentence](https://sentence.yourdictionary.com/quarantined): Sentence examples showing usage of 'quarantined' in various contexts
- [Examples of "Shed-light-on" in a Sentence](https://sentence.yourdictionary.com/shed-light-on): Idiom usage examples featuring Pasteur, Lister, and Gordon Ramsay
- [Examples of "Ring-up" in a Sentence](https://sentence.yourdictionary.com/ring-up): Phrasal verb examples showing 'ring-up' usage in everyday contexts
- [Examples of "Dysfunctions" in a Sentence](https://sentence.yourdictionary.com/dysfunctions): Word usage examples for 'dysfunctions' in medical and social contexts
- [Examples of "Self-promotion" in a Sentence](https://sentence.yourdictionary.com/self-promotion): Example sentences demonstrating 'self-promotion' usage with The Donald
- [Examples of "Helps-out" in a Sentence](https://sentence.yourdictionary.com/helps-out): Phrasal verb examples showing 'helps-out' in various sentence contexts
- [Examples of "Helped-out" in a Sentence](https://sentence.yourdictionary.com/helped-out): Past tense phrasal verb examples including Hurricane Katrina context
